brief:
Gaza's Health Ministry disclosed that 330 children have died after being prevented from traveling for medical treatment since the closure of the Rafah crossing, Shehab Wire reported. The deaths are part of a broader toll of more than 2,145 patients who died during the crossing's closure period.

An additional 21,500 sick and wounded patients remain awaiting permission to receive treatment outside the Gaza Strip.

title: Gaza Health Ministry reports 330 children died barred from treatment abroad
